title: Project 2: CI/CD pipeline with GitOps
summary: Give shipit a GitHub Actions pipeline: lint and test, multi-arch images on GHCR with cache, immutable tags, a Trivy gate, SBOM and provenance, Helm and Terraform checks with an ephemeral kind e2e, and pull-based GitOps delivery through Argo CD with approvals for production.
objectives: Design a pipeline around fast feedback, build-once-promote-many, immutable artifacts and least privilege
Build and push multi-arch images to GHCR with buildx, the GitHub Actions cache and a sha + semver tag strategy
Gate publication on a Trivy scan and attach SBOM, provenance and signed GitHub attestations
Validate Helm charts and Terraform in CI, including terraform test and an ephemeral end-to-end deploy on kind
Deploy with GitOps by committing image digests that Argo CD syncs, and explain why pull beats push for clusters
Use environments, required reviewers and OIDC federation, and run jobs locally with act
